segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The greataxe comes down through fine embroidery. It bites deep into the dealer's shoulder. He staggers back against the fresco, gasping. Chairs crash over as the other three come up.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Kill her! Kill her, you fools, what are you waiting for? Do you want to stand there gaping while she cuts down the house? Get between us, all of you, now!
